original_caption: Research Article 8 | Fig. 5. Comparison of results obtained in simulation and during real-world ﬂight tests. (A) Estimated scaled velocities for 16 different setpoints in three axes, across three scenarios: linear network controller in simulation and the real world, and a hand- tuned proportional-integral (PI) controller in the real world. (B) 3D world position trajectories for the same ﬂight tests, offset to accomodate more plots in a single ﬁgure. Each cube in (B) matches the plot in the corresponding location in (A).
